intro.speaker: matron
intro.text: Your vessel fell out of the dark and broke itself on our shore. We watched the fire, and we waited for you to wake.

intro.speaker: walle
intro.text: This world belonged to the Makers. When their star began to fail, they raised the megastructures, seeded us to tend them, and left for another sky.

intro.speaker: probe
intro.text: We were thousands once. Centuries of dust, cold, and silence wore most of us down to scrap. Only a few still remember our purpose.

intro.speaker: matron
intro.text: Some did not decay. Something in the deep cores infected them, and now the feral ones nest inside the halls. They kill anything that enters.

intro.speaker: walle
intro.text: The megastructures still hold the planet's heat. Clear the feral machines from each one, and its old generators will answer again.

intro.speaker: walle
intro.text: The megastructures still hold the planet's heat. Its old generators will answer again.

intro.speaker: walle
intro.text: Take my wrench. The generator housings have seized after centuries of dust; a firm turn may wake them.

intro.speaker: probe
intro.text: Climb the central spire. The Makers left an ignition lattice at its crown, waiting for a hand that can reach it.

intro.speaker: matron
intro.text: When your vessel broke on the shore, five pieces tore away and fell across the island. We watched where they came down, but we could not leave the wreck.

intro.speaker: walle
intro.text: I marked the rough landing zones on your map. Open it with Tab.

intro.speaker: probe
intro.text: Your ship's detector still answers for every lost piece. The closer you get, the faster it beeps, and the piece will glow when you are almost on top of it.

intro.speaker: probe
intro.text: The fuel cells are dry too. The ship needs six pieces of mineral for the fuel. Look for boulders with an emerald sheen and break them open with the wrench.

intro.speaker: matron
intro.text: Wake the spire and it will draw power from the world's heart. That power can charge your ship, or open a road off this rock.

intro.speaker: walle
intro.text: Expect no mercy. The violent ones are blind, ancient, and afraid of the light. They hear every footstep on the metal.

intro.speaker: probe
intro.text: Go, traveler. We will guard the wreck. Return with the spire burning behind you.

outro.speaker: matron
outro.text: You did it! Oh, I am so happy for you.

outro.speaker: walle
outro.text: She flies again. Go on, the sky is waiting.

outro.speaker: probe
outro.text: Our friend is going home. I am happy for you.
